chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Awrama, from Ali ibn Yahya, from Al-Walid ibn Al-'Ala', from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The one who causes gladness to enter upon a believer, he has caused it to enter upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family); and the one who causes it to enter upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), he has linked that to Allah (Exalted is He); and similarly, the one who causes distress to enter upon him (the believer).
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for making a believer happy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni presents this hadith to highlight the metaphysical chain of connection (wasila) between the believer and the Divine, where pleasing a single believer is tantamount to pleasing the Prophet and, by extension, God. This concept underscores the high spiritual status of the individual believer in Shia theology, serving as a practical guide for social conduct and emotional support within the community. The parallel drawn for causing sorrow reinforces the reciprocal nature of spiritual accountability in interpersonal relationships.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Awrama, from Ali Bin Yahya, from Al Waleed Bin Al A’ala, from Ibn Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one who causes the gladness to enter upon a Momin, so he has extended it towards Rasool-Allahsaww; and the one who enters it upon Rasool-Allahsaww, so he has linked that to Allahazwj. And similar to that is the one who enter the worries upon him (the Momin)’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Uramah from Ali ibn Yahya from al-Walid ibn al-‘Ala’ from ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Whoever sends joy to the heart of a believer he certainly has sent joy to the heart of the Messenger of Allah. If one sends joy to the heart of the Messenger of Allah such joy reaches Allah. The same is true of causing pain to the heart of a believer.”
